rationale: The stock has already collapsed ~18% from prior close, is sitting at 1.3% of today's range (essentially at the low), with only 21 minutes to close and forced liquidation at market. The risk/reward in either direction is unfavorable given the compressed time window and the likelihood of erratic end-of-day prints on a heavily dislocated name.
